transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because... even on my better days, I just can't shake this feeling. It's like... some people at my church and in my walking club are watching me. And it's not just that. I feel like they're putting little messages about me in the church bulletin, or hiding things in what they say when we're walking. It's just very unsettling.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people around you couldn't hear?

Well, yes, I suppose I have. Sometimes... usually when the house is real quiet, I'll hear my name being called, or just a few words. It sounds exactly like my friend's voice coming from the kitchen, or maybe out on the porch. It's so clear that I actually answer back out loud before I remember that I'm home alone and nobody is actually there.
Have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless lately?

Yes, I really have. It feels like... well, for most of this whole stretch, the sadness and feeling guilty, and just losing interest in things, it's all just been sitting there in the background. Even during the times when the voices aren't bothering me, or when those suspicious thoughts about people are a bit quieter... the sadness is still right there. It just doesn't seem to lift.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?

No, I can't say that I have. I've never really had a time where I felt wired or like I didn't need to sleep. Honestly, it's mostly just been the opposite, with feeling so down and tired all the time. I've never felt on top of the world like that.
Have you ever experienced those voices or suspicious feelings during a time when your mood was completely normal and you weren't feeling depressed?

Yes, I have. There was a spell... I guess it was a few weeks, where I was actually doing a bit better. I was getting dressed every day, eating a little more normally, and I didn't feel quite so heavy and weighed down by the sadness. But even during that time, when my mood was okay, I still heard my name being called in the empty house. And I still had those feelings that the people at my church were dropping hints about me behind my back. So, yes, those things happened even when I wasn't feeling depressed.
